economy.summary: His campaign says he has fought to keep government spending in check and prevent policies that would raise costs on families, and that he supports small businesses and economic growth.
economy.short: Says he fights spending and opposes policies raising family costs.

taxes.summary: His campaign says he supported state budgets that reduced spending, avoided broad-based tax increases, and protected the Rainy Day Fund, and that he supports easing the property tax burden.
taxes.short: Supported budgets reducing spending; backs property-tax relief.

education.summary: His campaign says he led a rewrite of Pennsylvania's career and technical education law to modernize workforce training and expand pathways for students into high-demand careers.
education.short: Led rewrite of Pennsylvania's career and technical education law.

energy.summary: His campaign says he opposed Pennsylvania joining the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, describing it as an energy tax that would have driven up electricity and heating costs.
energy.short: Opposed RGGI, calling it an energy tax raising costs.

abortion.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 77 of the 2017-2018 session, which would have established a dismemberment abortion ban and amended related provisions of the criminal code.
abortion.short: Co-sponsored 2017 bill to establish a dismemberment abortion ban.

guns.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 671 of the 2017-2018 session, which would strengthen state preemption limiting municipalities from enacting their own firearms and ammunition regulations.
guns.short: Co-sponsored 2017 bill limiting local firearms regulation.
